Done. Everything ran in the foreground to completion; the pier (PID 2519792, port 8093) is left running with the fix installed.

## Attribution — D1

`resolve-entries` on erpit's repack (9,048 objects), **2,196.0 ms** median of 6. Two independent methods: direct per-component loops, and 13 ablation copies of the real loop. They agree.

| component | ms | % |
|---|---:|---:|
| **`apply-delta`** (6,505 calls) | **1,238.0** | **56.4%** |
| **`object-oid`** (9,048 calls) | **867.7** | **39.5%** |
| — `canonical-object` | 90.8 | 4.1% |
| — `rev` in `sha1-octs` | 590.0 | 26.9% |
| — `sha-1l` | 186.9 | 8.5% |
| three `~(put by ...)` | 25.6 | 1.2% |
| `~(get by offsets)`, loop walk | 5.0 | 0.2% |
| **sum** | **2,136.3** | **97.3%** |
| unattributed | 59.7 | 2.7% |

**It closes.** Cross-checks: `object-oid` by removal gave 885.4 vs 867.7 direct; `rev` measured 598.8 on a third probe away from the loop.

## Verdict on 19 µs/instruction

**It does not generalize.** Cost per `apply-delta` call is `18.1 µs + 10.86 µs × instructions`. Measured µs/instruction across erpit's own objects: 29.0 at 1 instruction, 19.1 at 2, 15.0 at 5, 12.2 at 14–32, 11.0 at 129–512. Average over the pack: 12.4. 19 µs is the value for a 2-instruction object; the median object has 4.

The brief's arithmetic also used the wrong pack. 120,484 instructions and 202,472,812 canonical bytes are erpit's three original packs; the 2.34 s was measured on the repack, which has **99,603** instructions and **206,358,767** canonical bytes (confirmed in-ship and in Python). Of its three propositions, (1) and (2) are false and (3) holds.

## Top term and the fix — D2/D3

`apply-delta`, 56.4%. Inside it, the seven `optional-byte` calls per copy instruction measured **546 ms — 44.8% of `apply-delta`**, at 1.22 µs per call; the actual byte copying is 7.2%. `copy-instruction` now reads each field as one `cut` (98.5% of copy opcodes are contiguous runs), falling back to `copy-instruction-sparse` otherwise. One file, 49 lines added.

Second term `object-oid` is **out of scope**: `rev` costs 590 ms (345 MB/s) against SHA-1's 187 ms (1.10 GB/s), and `rev ≈ swp`, so the jet is firing. `sha-1l` reads its `byts` big-endian, and no arm in the running kernel hashes an `octs` in stored order. The fix would be a `shay`-style little-endian SHA-1 arm in `sys/hoon.hoon` plus a Vere jet near `u3we_shal`. Not shipped.

## Byte identity — D4

- 13,824-case probe over all 128 copy opcodes × 6 patterns × 9 truncations × 2 cursors: **0 mismatches**. (The first version failed 6 cases on a zero-byte mask past end-of-source, unreachable from `apply-delta`; fixed before commit.)
- Whole pack, both arms, full noun comparison on all 6,505 deltas: no difference. `mug 0x7b1d6883` before and after.
- erpit `master` pushed with stock git (no `-c`), pack had **5,169 REF_DELTA objects, chains to depth 40**; cloned back: object set `5cc7922a…`, content stream `8fb13224…`, deltified-only stream `30762e02…` — all identical, `git fsck --full` exit 0.
- All 18 conformance vectors match `PUSH-DEFECTS.md` §4c.

| | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| `apply-delta` | 1,238.0 ms | **781.5 ms** (−36.9%) |
| `resolve-entries` | 2,196.0 ms | **1,702.5 ms** (−22.5%) |
| `decode-pack-with` | 2,345.8 ms | **1,886.7 ms** (−19.6%) |
| **stock `git push`, `/usr/bin/time`** | **1.87 s** | **1.56 s** (−16.8%) |

Three independent push series agree. Builds were swapped on the same pier and each confirmed by scry before its series.

## Left undone

- **New defect, out of scope:** a clone of a many-ref repository returns HTTP 400. Git gzips large `upload-pack` request bodies (`Content-Encoding: gzip`); `parse-upload-request` reads them as pkt-lines and fails. Proxy-recorded: 1,438 bytes on the wire, 3,023 gunzipped, valid v2 `fetch` with 58 wants. Recorded in §6.
- A 148 MB clone bails `meme` in a 2 GB loom; needs `--loom 32`.
- The `%ref` branch is proven correct by the round trip and is inside the external timing, but was not attributed on its own.
- The remaining 782 ms of `apply-delta` (7.8 µs/instruction) is not broken down further.

Two commits on `feat/progress-and-joinall`, not pushed: `b53e06f` (fix) and `035673f` (`RESOLVE-ENTRIES-PERFORMANCE.md`).
